description: Read a WarmInboxes operator note, guide, study, playbook, dataset, recipe, comparison or changelog entry in full, as markdown. Long pages come in parts split at headings: the first call says how many, and nextPart gives the one to ask for. Datasets also return their data as JSON. Use the url find_resources gave you. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

part.description: Which part of a long page, from 1. Defaults to 1.

url.description: The page, as find_resources returned it, e.g. "https://warminboxes.com/research/inbox-placement-log", or a note as "note:<id>". A path works too.

name: read_resource

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.

title: Read a guide or study
